Oslo in January is cold and dark. Expect temperatures around -5°C to -10°C (23°F to 14°F), often dropping below -15°C (5°F) at night. Snow cover is likely, with 6-8 hours of daylight (sunrise ~9 AM, sunset ~3 PM). Pack warm layers, waterproof boots, and a good winter coat.
